blocks.text: Repeated transit signals build a hot, unstable rhythm in the pet’s signal.
Location: The Underway of Returning Signals
Appearance: Detailed heat wisps rise slowly from the pet; reduced motion holds them in place.
Care: Antiseptic wipes or broad-spectrum antibiotics; cleaning supports recovery.
Story connection: Following the repeated call could locate a stranded relay.

New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed Era Three transit location, derived from dormant transit corridors becoming dangerous underways and from Corridor/Relay history.
